visual.general_description: Two greyscale echocardiogram sector images side by side (left and right), each with scanner text.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side greyscale ultrasound sector images on black backgrounds, apex at the top. Each shows a heart chamber view with a large dark chamber cavity at the right-centre bordered by brighter wall and septal structures. Scanner annotation text is at the upper left of each image (probe, frequency, depth, gain and speed style lines), a grey scale bar is at the upper right, a small orientation marker and a small ECG trace are at the lower left, and a heart-rate label reading 47 BPM is at the lower right (legible; same value in both images). The right image differs slightly in cavity outline from the left. No panel letters are printed.

visual.general_description: Two greyscale coronary angiogram frames side by side (left and right) with contrast-filled arteries.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side greyscale fluoroscopic frames separated by a thin black line. The left frame shows a branching contrast-filled artery network with a main trunk dividing into several branches that run across the image toward the right and lower right, over a faint chest background with a bright band at the upper right. The right frame shows a single thick contrast-filled artery that loops in a large curve from the top down and to the left and then right, with thinner branches at the right, over a faint spine-like structure at the bottom. No printed text, labels, arrows or scale are visible and no panel letters are printed.
